steps.title: Open the Trendora workstation
steps.narration: Welcome to Trendora, a research-only stock scanner. The app opens on the Dashboard, and right away the header confirms the workstation is already connected to its data backend.
steps.point_out: The green 'Backend OK' badge in the top-right (provider: seed, seed 2026-05-28, 158 symbols) and the persistent left sidebar listing all seven destinations.

steps.title: Browse to Stocks
steps.narration: Clicking 'Stocks' in the sidebar opens the Stock Leaderboard. It's empty for now, with a friendly note describing the Leadership, Entry Quality and Risk scores that will rank stocks here soon.
steps.point_out: The page switches to /stocks, the 'Stocks' link gets a teal active highlight, and a 'No ranked stocks yet' card explains what's coming.

steps.title: Browse to Themes
steps.narration: Next, the Themes section — where investment themes will be ranked by a price-confirmed Theme Score.
steps.point_out: The 'No ranked themes yet' card, and the active highlight following your click to 'Themes'.

steps.title: Browse to Sectors
steps.narration: The Sectors view will rank sector and industry ETFs by Sector Score, so you can see where market leadership is concentrated.
steps.point_out: The 'No ranked sectors yet' card and the Sectors link now highlighted.

steps.title: Browse to Scanner Runs
steps.narration: Scanner Runs keeps a history of every daily scan as an immutable, dated snapshot — so past results never change after they're saved.
steps.point_out: The 'No scanner runs yet' card; once daily scans run, each appears here as its own saved snapshot.

steps.title: Browse to System Health
steps.narration: System Health is where the product proves itself — forward-tested evidence showing whether the rankings actually work.
steps.point_out: The 'No evidence yet' card; walk-forward returns by score bucket will land here in a later iteration.

steps.title: Browse to Watchlist
steps.narration: Your Watchlist holds the stocks you save, and it persists across restarts.
steps.point_out: The 'Your watchlist is empty' card, ready for saved stocks with your reason and the date added.

steps.title: Open a stock's detail page
steps.narration: Even with no data yet, deep-link pages already resolve. Here's the detail page for NVDA, reached directly by its URL rather than from the sidebar.
steps.point_out: A real 'NVDA' page with a 'Detail not available yet' card — not a 404 — proving the per-stock detail route is wired for later.

steps.title: Open a scanner run's detail page
steps.narration: Likewise, an individual scanner run has its own page. Here's Run #1, ready to show that run's exact, immutable snapshot once real scans exist.
steps.point_out: The 'Run #1' heading with a 'Run detail not available yet' card; the route resolves cleanly even before any run has been recorded.
